Edit maximum growth rate (mum) for all age classes across functional groups

edit_param_mum_group_age.Rd

Replaces the mum values in a biology parameter file for one or more functional groups. Each group is matched with grep on its code:

  • vector.size > 1: matches mum_<Code> <vector.size> and replaces the age-class values on the following line.

  • vector.size = 1: matches mum_<Code>_T15 and replaces the value on that line.

Groups that are not found in bio.lines are skipped with a warning.

Usage

edit_param_mum_group_age(
  bio.lines,
  new.mum,
  overwrite = F,
  new.file.name,
  single.group = F,
  vector.size = 10,
  group.name = NULL,
  bio.prm = NULL
)

Arguments

bio.lines

Character vector of lines from the biology .prm file, typically the result of readLines().

new.mum

Numeric matrix of replacement mum values. Rows are named by functional-group code; columns correspond to age classes 1 through vector.size. When single.group = TRUE, a numeric vector of length vector.size.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, write the modified lines back to bio.prm; if FALSE (default) save a copy at new.file.name.

new.file.name

Character. Output file path used when overwrite = FALSE.

single.group

Logical. If TRUE, only the group named group.name is updated. Default is FALSE.

vector.size

Integer. Number of age classes per functional group. Default is 10.

group.name

Character. Code of the functional group to update. Required when single.group = TRUE. Default is NULL.

bio.prm

Character. Path to the biology .prm file that is overwritten. Required when single.group = TRUE and overwrite = TRUE. Default is NULL.

Value

Modified bio.lines vector (returned only when single.group = FALSE); otherwise NULL, called for its side effect of writing a file.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  bio.lines <- readLines("AMPSbioparam.prm")
  new.mum <- matrix(0.01, nrow = 2, ncol = 10,
                    dimnames = list(c("CHY", "COH"), NULL))
  bio.lines <- edit_param_mum_group_age(bio.lines, new.mum)
} # }
